evals.prompt: Here's our Playwright test suite (zip attached). Can you take a look and tell me what needs fixing? It's been flaky for weeks.
evals.expected_output: Markdown report file; flakiness findings tied to specific file:line evidence; Critical/High severity assigned to false-confidence and gating issues; remediation plan sequenced

evals.prompt: Review this repo on GitLab and draw up a report on what we could improve: <repo url>
evals.expected_output: Repo mapped before reading; lenses selected to match actual stack; 10-25 findings; Coverage and confidence section honestly listing what wasn't read

evals.prompt: Quick sanity check on this .gitlab-ci.yml before I merge it - anything dumb in here?
evals.expected_output: Scoped report, not padded to 20 findings; catches gating/secrets/caching issues; states that fragment scope limits architectural findings
